title: Passives in the News
goal: Choose between the ser passive, passive se and estar with a participle in a news report.

items: I can name who did something with the *ser* passive and *por* (*fueron rescatadas por los bomberos*).
I can leave the doer out with *se* (*se detuvo a dos personas*, *se cortaron las calles*).
I can say how things stand now with *estar* and a participle (*el puente está cortado*).
